psychological_meaning: Lima is a vibrant and energetic green that evokes feelings of freshness, growth, and vitality. It is associated with nature, health, and renewal, conveying a sense of optimism and well-being. This color can inspire feelings of balance and harmony, promoting a sense of connection with the natural world and encouraging a positive outlook.
